notes.title: Troll Folk of Thile
notes.notes:
Much of the world of Thile currently holds quite generic D&D / Tolkien monsters, such as goblins and orcs.
Treacherous Journeys is meant to be more than that, and have a stronger direct European folklore influence. The new elven starting area last year was the first part of this development, and now it will soon be time to meet more of the troll folk of Thile.
And this time, by troll folk we mean actual trolls!
Still in a concept phase, these creatures will vary a lot in appearance and temperament.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43703082/4047e55371184796435e296c53ebb2226f72f209.png[/img]


Also - in an upcoming patch not too far into the future it might be worth it to take another look at Ynna's well :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43703082/38d1ce452c3795ce785645f45675ece6194bee3e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Custom Characters, Development Focus
notes.notes:
[h1]Custom Characters[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43703082/fe92f94276e84f2be3bfbc1b20171f2193404323.png[/img]
A couple of different character assets have been used for Treacherous Journeys through its development, and although they're nice I've always wanted custom player characters rather than stock assets.
Finally I can announce that a pair of custom characters which the team has been working on for a while are now almost ready!

In fact, they're already released in the playtest, but the female is still missing her texture.
Our texture artist is on the case though, and it won't be long before she will be ready too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43703082/dfe221f2ba2672c2a731867cd54388d83639b8fd.png[/img]

[h1]Masteries and Skills[/h1]
Apart from creating the custom player characters and putting them into the game for you all to see, serious work is now being done on the mastery classes along with an assortment of skills to go with them.

It's still too early to share much, but I think you will all be pleasantly surprised!

notes.title: New Pre-Alpha Playtest, introducing the Cairn Keepers, folklore
notes.notes:
[h1][/h1]
Become a Cairn Keeper in Treacherous Journeys!

The Wanderers' Circle, the ancient order to keep the paths safe, has seen decline with the rise of kingdoms.
But as the old cairnstones are neglected along with the connection to the spirit world, old fears are now becoming real.
Along with some new ones. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43703082/bc8acc8591a4f55e7eae6cd93f9f8f4264117382.png[/img]

A brand new starting area with a stronger folklore theme needs testing. If you have played before please try with a new character.

PS: There are rumors the lightning spell has been changed...

Whether you've tried the game in the past or have just learned of Treacherous Journeys, your input is very important!

To participate in the test, simply sign up for the playtest on the store page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332180/Treacherous_Journeys/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332180/Treacherous_Journeys/[/url]. At the start of the event I expect to be able to let everyone who has signed up in.

Also, consider joining the official Discord server, where you can discuss the game, read news and updates, and give feedback:

notes.title: Happy New Year from Treacherous Journeys!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everyone, and thank you for following the development of Treacherous Journeys!

Last year we had 2 rounds of open playtest, and the current playtest is still open to new plaers, so if you didn't try it yet don't hessitate to request access, which will be automatically granted!

Since then work has continued - some issues raised during playtest have been addressed, and autogenerated dungeons have been prototyped. It's still some time away from being done, but it might be possible to discover the portal to the prototype already!

Currently the focus is on the experience for new players, and on making the identity of the game more apparent. Rats, spiders and goblins are here to stay, but you will soon be seeing more beings from European folklore, so tread lightly! 

PS: Feedback and suggestions are always welcome and I enjoy talking to all of you! I'm actively following this community, but I hope to see a lot of you in the Discord too!

notes.title: Treacherous Journeys Prealpha Playtest
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi all![/h1]
The Online Action RPG Treacherous Journeys has been playtested and showcased a bit on other platforms, but now it's time for a proper playtest.

Therefore I invite all of You to join the first public pre-alpha playtest right here on Steam, where you will get a chance to experience the beginning of the game in its current state and I will get a chance to get valuable feedback!

If you have tested this game before then I encourage you to try it again, since many changes have been added since. The most important change of course is the addition of proper classes! 3 are planned for the game and will be available for the test:

[h2]Brawler[/h2]
Brawlers have a flair for physical violence and can take a beating too. They're born fighters; hitting things and standing fast against the enemy is what they do. 

Some specialize in offensive combat, learning how to master weapons of all sorts to inflict the maximum possible damage. 

Others have a commanding presence and brain in addition to brawn, which lets them inspire courage in a team and even bolster their defenses with magic.

Still, many brawlers find the best way to serve the team is to master the shield, standing as a bulwark against the foe. 
----~~~~~~~----

[h2]Savant[/h2]
Some adventurers have an innate attunement to the magical forces that shape this world. These savants are able to learn incredible spells, defying the reality most people recognize. 

Elementalists consider their mastery the purest form of magic, drawing from the raw elemental forces to create even more powerful magic. 

Charismatic savants who learn the magics of the mind are a great addition to any party, buffing both their defensive and offensive capabilities. 

Lastly, savants appreciating the beauty and brutality of the natural world can learn to draw from these wild forces, which offer both healing and destruction.
----~~~~~~~----

[h2]Pathfinder[/h2]
Pathfinders tend to travel light, preferring freedom and mobility over heavy armor. They're skilled hunters who are adept at ranged weapons, but can also be vicious fighters up close.

Pathfinders who specialize in marksmanship have been known to perform incredible feats with their bows, letting arrows rain down on their foes or releasing just one single, well-aimed shot that always seems to find its mark.

With their knowledge of nature, many pathfinders find it possible to even tap into Primalist magic.

Strong pathfinders who aren't afraid to get up close and personal will often study weapons mastery.
----~~~~~~~----

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43703082/81537a49e71e62d917191516e725136949feeef3.png[/img]

In addition to these classes, a number of mastery classes are planned which will significantly influence the play experience. These will not be available in the test, but might be revealed in the playtest period.

To participate in the test, simply sign up for the playtest on the store page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332180/Treacherous_Journeys/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332180/Treacherous_Journeys/[/url]. At the start of the event I expect to be able to let everyone who has signed up in.

Also, consider joining the official Discord server, where you can discuss the game, read news and updates, and give feedback:

[url=https://discord.gg/R2Cet5QUaB] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43703082/c66d7de1d3a1fe5959a3ebcd269b6545fca86481.png[/img][/url]

[b]I'm looking forward to meeting all of you in the land of Thile![/b]

Regards,
[i]Jesper Nielsen
Dire Prism[/i]
